title: One-bit two-function hypercontractivity
statement: Let $r,s\in[0,1]$ and $0\leq\rho\leq\sqrt{rs}$. For real-valued functions $f,g$ on the two-point sign space, let $(X,Y)$ have the law obtained by choosing $X$ uniformly and, with probability $(1+\rho)/2$, setting $Y=X$, and otherwise setting $Y=-X$. Then $\mathbb{E}[f(X)g(Y)]\leq \|f\|_{1+r}\|g\|_{1+s}$, with both norms taken under the uniform law on the sign space.
hypotheses_covered: $f,g$ are real-valued functions on the sign space
